ctx.x: So with Ina Rae Hutton, I forget what I used to write for her, but I used to -- Dizzy Gillespie was writing for WHEN Boyd Ina Rae, I was writing for Ina Rae, she would come in. Board Rabin, Dizzy Gillespie, Tad Damon and myself, we were --and I don't want to forget this guy's name, I'll recall it in a Boyd Rabin minute. We were all writing for Board Rabin. Jimmy Noone --
well, that was back in the Chicago days -- He was one of the -- Ben Goodman's influences.
